physics.classification: 文献参数假设模型；非 Zhang 定量复现
physics.scope: Frozen three-layer approximate model; no new FDTD, training or experimental validation

definitions.pilot: 额外专用完整训练帧 K（可知完整输入共 K+1）
definitions.known_complete_inputs: K+1 due to public fixed 16-bit length header
definitions.noise_reference: full8192 complex detector components iid circular Gaussian; each quadrature sigma=sqrt(P_ref*10^(-SNR/10)/2); P_ref=mean over16 nominal channels sum(abs(A)^2)/(8192), i.e. expected unit-energy randomBPSK output power per complex component. Sigma fixed across inputs/budgets; no signal renormalization.
definitions.energy_rule: main each complete BPSK frame norm2=1; each symbol1/16; total incident norm F+K. Fixed-total counterpart sets amplitude sqrt((F+1)/(F+K)), fixed detector noise unchanged. Unit is normalized incident field norm, not measured joule.
definitions.sampling_unit: each condition uses independent calibration sessions; repeated K and methods share sessions. Ten cumulative clusters reuse parameters from ten validation sessions, so all759 distinct IDs are not pooled as independent trials.
definitions.confidence: pointwise two-sided95% exact Clopper-Pearson for curves; one-sided95% lower bound for preregistered99% confirmation; no familywise correction

parameter_errors.alpha_error_deg: absolute error modulo180deg after common complex gain equivalence
parameter_errors.distance_error_um: absolute L2-L3 entrance-plane distance error in micrometres
parameter_errors.bands: q10/q90 descriptive quantiles, not confidence intervals

definitions.missing_policy: absent exact tuple means NOT_RUN; no nearest fallback or interpolated result
definitions.adaptive_K_groups: by_condition adaptive K rows are selected stopping subsets, not randomized fixed-budget policies; use adaptive_comparison for policy totals

counts.session_count_definition: distinct session IDs:450 validation +299 confirmation +10 reused-parameter clusters; not one pooled independent binomial n

adaptive_confirmation.interpretation: pointwise preregistered condition only; not minimum fixed K, general reliability or secrecy proof

limitations: 冻结的0.7THz三层近似传播；没有新FDTD、整片全波或实验验证。
预配置信道的优势来自事先信息，不来自合法用户身份。
直角附近±3°内最近邻位置映射不变，本研究的角度响应主要来自Jones变化，不能据此验证真实器件的亚度容差。
主实验负载仅4个大写英文字母或数字，即4个ASCII字节。不能推广到任意长消息或中文消息。
经验消息恢复不等于互信息、保密容量、密钥位数或安全证明。
固定长度头提供额外公开已知输入，K=0不是零公开训练信息。
确认区间为预指定条件内逐项区间，未作多方案或跨条件的同时置信保证。

paired_derivation.method: Existing analyze.py aggregate; same session_id subsets as figures 08/09, limited to K present in both arms; all outcomes retained
paired_derivation.fixed_total_energy: validation joint drift, reference SNR40/60; L; baseline per-symbol energy fixed versus fixed total energy6; same10 sessions per condition
paired_derivation.search_budget: validation joint drift, reference SNR60; E1; baseline2x160+16 coarse versus4x320+16 coarse; same10 sessions; K1/4/16
paired_derivation.pairing: Each arm has exactly the same10 session IDs at each matched K; aggregates only, no per-session secrets published
